image_description: A vintage green agricultural plow (likely a moldboard plow) is being pulled by draft animals (horses/mules, partially visible on the left) through a field. A farmer wearing a hat and blue shirt sits on the plow's seat, holding the reins. The plow has multiple large, curved metal blades (moldboards) that are actively turning over thick slices of reddish-brown soil. The background features rolling hills, a farmstead with red buildings, and a hazy sky.
